claims.originating_goal: Project the canonical automatic, selected, and effective task security-posture identities into MyKV and Organizational KV without allowing Site UI to become posture or transition authority.
claims.claim_expires_when: Release after the UI displays automatic, selected, and effective posture provenance, rejects selection below the automatic floor, and binds to canonical task-specific posture state without granting Site policy or transition authority.
expected_evidence: MyKV and Organizational KV visibly display automatic, selected, and effective posture identifiers
weaker-than-automatic posture choices are disabled or rejected
Site UI consumes canonical posture state rather than minting authoritative posture
no Interlock/InTr or TV/TVC authority is granted by UI selection
collision_boundaries: Do not make Site a security-policy authority
Do not let UI selection downgrade the ecosystem-computed automatic floor
Do not mint transition or credential authority from posture display state
Preserve current MyKV and Organizational KV node semantics
claims.next_task_after_release: Bind Site posture projection to the exact task-scoped posture object emitted by the canonical Interlock/InTr resolver.
